title: Mitsubishi C010A insert identity corrections and BF/BM baselines, part 1 of 6
purpose: Correct legacy edge-preparation/grade interpretation for all Mitsubishi inserts and publish source-backed BF/BM adjustable baselines.

sources.title: Mitsubishi Materials CBN & PCD Inserts Catalog C010A
sources.edition_evidence: Manufacturer-hosted catalog; exact product rows and recommendation tables.

tool_updates.description: Mitsubishi Materials positive CBN insert BF-CCGT09T304TS2, with BF breaker and TS2 edge preparation. Catalog grade options are BC8210, BC8110. Published cutting conditions are manufacturer grade- or breaker-level baselines intended for machinist adjustment.

evidence.source_table_ref: C010A positive CBN insert standards / exact BF-CCGT09T304TS2 row
evidence.source_raw_text: Exact order designation BF-CCGT09T304TS2 carries TS2; available material grades are shown in separate C010A grade columns.

facts.value_text: TS2 is an edge-preparation/order suffix, not the material grade; catalog grade options are BC8210, BC8110.
